page.content:
Half-orc warlock-paladin who captains the Nein Heroez.

How Fjord connects

  • Character: Travis Willingham — Travis Willingham plays Fjord.
  • Faction: Mighty Nein — Fjord often captains the Mighty Nein on land and sea.

What is Fjord?

Fjord is Travis Willingham's Campaign 2 lead, a coastal half-orc who takes a uk'otoa pact, then the Wildmother, and a ship the Mighty Nein keep almost sinking.

Key threads lead to Travis Willingham and Mighty Nein.
